summary_full: Data Scientist and AI Engineer with 5+ years of experience, including 3+ years in North American industry, spanning production machine learning, computer vision, deep learning, generative AI, agentic systems, and cloud engineering. Hands-on record of delivering ML systems for railway safety, video analytics, biomedical research, NLP, and enterprise automation, with strengths across Python, SQL, Azure, model pipelines, RAG, and productionization. Experienced in translating complex technical problems into scalable, reliable AI solutions. Canadian work history includes a combination of industry experience and graduate research.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Built an AI software architect that converts complex requirements into structured requirements, solution architectures, Azure recommendations, delivery plans, and technical designs, including architecture assessment against organizational standards.
Automated the end-to-end clinical workflow from CMS ingestion to final patient delivery, eliminating manual data entry and accelerating report turnaround times.
Designed and built an agentic ITSM platform on Azure DevOps using the Microsoft Agent Framework, RAG, enterprise knowledge, and workflow automation to accelerate service delivery.

experience.title: Data Scientist
bullets: Led production computer vision systems for railway safety, including object detection for trespasser detection and track segmentation from moving locomotives.
Migrated YOLOv5-based detection models to YOLOv7, improving detection accuracy and real-time processing speed for driver-behaviour and railway-infrastructure monitoring.
Designed computer vision solutions for infrastructure inspection, crew-behaviour monitoring, and passenger-occupancy estimation under motion blur, changing viewpoints, and variable illumination.
Built scalable ML data pipelines and model workflows using Python and SQL, supporting repeatable training, evaluation, and deployment across multiple products.
Created reusable, versioned Python packages with testing and documentation, establishing engineering standards and improving maintainability and cross-team adoption.

experience.title: Lead AI Engineer

Developed CI/CD for a C++ application using unit testing, Azure DevOps, and Docker to support repeatable integration and deployment.
Integrated Raspberry Pi 4 with ADE9000 to capture and analyze voltage, current, and power measurements for data monitoring.

experience.title: Graduate Services Assistant

experience.title: Machine Learning Intern
